name: Mika Slayton
source:
She is the Junker Headquarters Operator.
Mika graduated from Kobe City University with a double major in Criminal Psychology and Municipal Data Management. Mika comes from a mixed Jewish and Japanese household. After graduation, she joined the Neo Kobe Special Criminal Research Center. After leaving that, she assumed her current position at the Junker Agency.

[From [url=http://www.justinaaron.com/thekremlin/mika.html]The Kremlin[/url]]
